chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Nuʿaym ibn Ibrāhīm, from Ghiyāth, who said:
I asked Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام about a man who said to another man, “You indeed do the act of the people of Lūṭ.” He said, “He is to be given the punishment of the slanderer: eighty lashes.”

key_terms.ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً: eighty lashes, the stated hadd punishment
key_terms.حَدَّ الْقَاذِفِ: the prescribed legal punishment for one who makes a false sexual accusation
key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man, the subject of both the question and the ruling
key_terms.عَمَلَ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ: the act associated with the people of Lūṭ, used here as an accusation
key_terms.يُضْرَبُ: he is to be struck or flogged as a legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on accusing someone of committing the act of the people of Lūṭ in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person who accuses another of committing the act of the people of Lūṭ. Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام rules that such a speaker is subject to the hadd punishment of a slanderer, namely eighty lashes.
